recorded: 2026-09-29, gfx1151 Strix Halo (zbook, AMD Radeon 8060S, 126976 MiB), ROCm SDK via ~/miniforge3 site-packages
why: The 4096-token prefill census (artifact 2026-09-29-gemma4-gfx1151-prefill-ladder-and-attention-share.json) attributed 61.0 percent of the step to gemma4_attention_prefill_bf16 at 276 GFLOP/s, about 1 percent of this part's BF16 rate. This row measures a BF16 WMMA replacement for the 25 sliding-window layers on the same device buffers, shapes, mask and arguments as the strict row it is compared against.
not_a_promotion: Nothing in the production path selects this kernel: attention_symbol, the layer wrapper, the runtime and dispatch all still resolve to the strict kernel, which is byte-for-byte unchanged. The changed-arithmetic gate in docs/EXECUTION-PROFILES.md has not been run and is not claimed. Registration under the variant gemma4_wmma_flash is additive and unreachable by any existing resolution.

candidate.geometry: head_dim 256, 16 query heads, 8 KV heads, GQA ratio 2, window 1024, causal -- the sliding layers, 25 of 30
candidate.tiling: QUERY_ROWS 16 x GQA_HEADS 2 = 32 WMMA columns, 64 threads (2 waves), K_BATCH 32, 33.8 KB LDS
candidate.resources: VGPRs 256 (the ISA ceiling for wave32), TotalSGPRs 40, ScratchSize 16 bytes/lane, VGPRs Spill 3
candidate.unsupported: head_dim 512 (the 5 full layers) raises NotImplementedError rather than running a different geometry
candidate.arithmetic: changed -- the score dot is reassociated through the 16x16x16 F16 matrix unit and the softmax weights are rounded to FP16 before the P*V dot. Not claimed bit-exact.

measurement.instrument: scripts/gemma4_attention_prefill_bench.py --compare-wmma, median of 5 launches after 2 warmups, device-synchronized per launch
measurement.comparability: both rows are timed on the same device buffers with the same shapes, the same keep mask and the same arguments, and both GFLOP/s figures divide by the same windowed causal pair count

swa_256d_16q_8kv_window_0_probe.note: not a model configuration; isolates how much of the win is the block-level walk trim

measurement.repeatability: strict 462.6/459.0/462.0/465.3 GFLOP/s and candidate 6017/6345/6290/6280 GFLOP/s across four separate runs, one device in one clock state; not measured across reboots, clock states, thermal states or a second device
measurement.independent_reproduction: 130.63 ms -> 9.58 ms (13.64x) reproduced by the lead on the same command after the candidate was written, against the author's 130.17 ms -> 9.48 ms (13.73x)

ceiling.instrument: standalone wmma_f32_16x16x16_f16_w32 throughput probe, 5120 blocks x 2 waves, not committed
ceiling.dependent_chain_tflops: 50.4 at 20000 deep, so the tensor unit is throughput-limited rather than latency-limited and accumulator splitting is not the lever
ceiling.candidate_share: the kernel's raw tensor-core work runs at ~7.1 TFLOP/s, about 14 percent of the probe
ceiling.ablation: removing the global loads from both K/V staging passes (keeping the conversion and LDS stores, wrong results, timing only) takes 9.99 ms to 5.66 ms, so 43 percent of the runtime is global-load cost in staging; removing the P*V value-fragment read is only 9 percent, which rules out the LDS read pattern

correctness.oracle: the strict gemma4_attention_prefill_bf16 kernel, driven through ctypes on the same device buffers with the same arguments, so the only difference between the outputs is the arithmetic
correctness.result: 20 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed; independently reproduced by the lead
correctness.cases: real sliding geometry at 512 and 1024 tokens; the production mask frame gemma4_layer passes (row_offset = window - 1, keys = tokens + window - 1); chunked prefill with row_offset > 0 and keys > tokens at (512, 1024, 512) and (256, 4096, 3840); window == 0 with random, blocky and fully-masked-row masks; tokens < QUERY_ROWS at (1,1), (5,8), (15,16) and (17,32); narrow windows 1, 2, 4 and 17; scale 0.25; the launcher refusing head_dim 512; attention_symbol still selecting the strict kernel
correctness.tolerance: RTOL 7.9e-3 relative to each case's output peak (about four BF16 ulps) plus exact NaN-placement equality; the measured worst ratio is 3.7e-3, so the bound carries about 2.1x margin
correctness.agreement: 99.0-99.6 percent of output BF16 bit patterns are identical across every case; the worst absolute difference is 1.562e-2, one BF16 ulp at the largest output magnitude
correctness.bound_teeth: injecting an off-by-one into the leading walk trim fails the production-frame cases, the (256, 4096, 3840) chunked case and all four narrow-window cases, while the real-geometry and window == 0 cases still pass -- the expected shape of a trim bug, and the honest limit of a four-ulp bound at window 1024
correctness.not_verified: no float64 CPU reference and no quality metric; the comparison is against the strict kernel only

not_verified: End-to-end prefill or generation throughput. The claim is the kernel's rate at the model's geometry in isolation. The whole-model gap closing is a separate measurement that has not been run, because nothing selects this kernel yet.
The head_dim-512 full layers (5 of 30) are not implemented.
No execution-profile gate, calibration run, or promotion.
next: Promotion is a product call. If yes, the changed-arithmetic gate in docs/EXECUTION-PROFILES.md and the rollup in docs/OPTIMIZATION.md apply before the strict kernel stops being the default. The head_dim-512 full layers are the other half of the attention FLOPs and are a separate unit. The staging prefetch named in the ablation is the remaining rate on this one.
